_readme: Kit v2 config. Read by .claude/hooks/*.ps1, .claude/scripts/*.ps1, the skills, and the agents. Run /customize-kit to fill it in. Empty values disable the related feature; a missing key takes the default in USER-GUIDE §12 'kit.json keys'. Commands run from the project (or worktree) root via 'cmd.exe /c'. Placeholders: {file} = edited file (verify.fast), {tests} = space-separated test files (testAudit.run, testAudit.runners[].run), {port} = per-task dev-server port (ui.*). Project-specific instructions for a skill or agent go in .claude/project/<name>.md, never in the kit's own files.
